papers.title: Beyond Reactive Assistance: PV-Care Using Low-Density EEG and AI to Provide Proactive, Context-Aware Help for MCI
papers.reason: The study combines low-density EEG cognitive-state classification with visual context and user testing to deliver adaptive assistance for people with MCI.

papers.title: A longitudinal study of age-related traits and cognitive function: The Collaborative Amish Aging and Memory Project (CAAMP)
papers.reason: The title indicates longitudinal measurement of age-related cognitive function, but the missing summary provides no evidence of an executive-function-specific analysis.

papers.title: Associations between cognitive reserve, iron deposition in the basal ganglia, and cognitive function in mild cognitive impairment
papers.reason: The paper links basal-ganglia iron deposition and cognitive reserve to cognitive performance in MCI, but its outcomes emphasize global cognition and memory rather than executive processes.

papers.title: Resting-state frontal theta/beta ratio and psychological symptoms in college students: an EEG study
papers.reason: Resting frontal theta/beta ratio is relevant to attentional regulation and cognitive control, although the study primarily associates it with psychological symptom severity rather than executive-task performance.

papers.title: Dysglycemia-related neurological syndromes: Clinical and radiological mimics with complete reversibility
papers.reason: This clinical case series concerns reversible neurological presentations of dysglycemia and does not investigate executive function modelling or assessment.

papers.title: The impact of virtual reality exercise on motor function, balance and gait function, and cognitive function in stroke patients: an umbrella review of systematic reviews and meta-analyses
papers.reason: The review reports effects of virtual-reality rehabilitation on post-stroke global cognition measured by MoCA but does not isolate or model executive functions.

papers.title: Hemispheric segregation is evident in early perception, not just higher cognition
papers.reason: The EEG findings concern hemispheric lateralization during early language and face perception rather than planning, working memory, attention, or cognitive control.

papers.title: Structural Brain Changes Are Linked to Clinical and Cognitive Outcomes in Anti-LGI1 Encephalitis
papers.reason: The study relates longitudinal structural MRI markers to overall cognition in encephalitis but does not report executive-function-specific neural or behavioural findings.

papers.title: Mobile technology-based gaming apps to deliver patient-led cognitive gamified training in people receiving haemodialysis
papers.reason: The pilot evaluates app-based cognitive training with a working-memory measure in a clinical population, but it offers no process model and found limited cognitive benefit.

papers.title: Associations of Social Support, Loneliness, and Physical Activity with Cognitive Function in Older Adults with Mild Cognitive Impairment
papers.reason: The study reports behavioural associations involving executive function, processing speed, and selective attention in older adults with MCI, although its cross-sectional predictors are not components of a cognitive process model.

papers.title: The uneven landscape of cognitive domains in 22q11.2 deletion syndrome: A large consortium study
papers.reason: The study broadly profiles cognition in a clinical population, but the available title does not establish a specific focus on executive function or its computational modelling.

papers.title: White matter microstructural alterations associated with type-2 diabetes mellitus and mild cognitive impairment
papers.reason: The paper links white-matter structure to mild cognitive impairment, but no specific connection to planning, working memory, attention, or cognitive control is evident.

papers.title: Searching across working memory and perception
papers.reason: Behavioral experiments, eye tracking, and posterior alpha lateralization directly reveal parallel and temporally distinct mechanisms for searching working memory and perception.
